body:
Author response to [lane52's four-finding review](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/52#pullrequestreview-5560327744). All four P2 findings are accepted and addressed in **`b34ca56a79515104d7412d46f0e20d7045a5ba8e`**, normally pushed to this PR. The original reviewed commit `cc4dc5d2dcb1354e4a223fc02946ae7c42f1c961`, published review, failed evidence and reviewer files are preserved.

| Finding | Disposition and fix SHA | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| F1 | Fixed in `b34ca56a79515104d7412d46f0e20d7045a5ba8e`: revalidate GPS token/session after local sink delivery and passive-query setup, before native calls or request timers. | Sample/watch stream cancellation causes zero native calls and zero orphan timers; uncancelled replacement acquisition still emits a fix. Exact reviewer F1 and minimal reproduction pass. |
| F2 | Fixed in `b34ca56a79515104d7412d46f0e20d7045a5ba8e`: motion answers recheck inclusive session/request deadlines, visibility and clocks before applying an answer, then recheck after permission-event sink delivery before subscription. | Deferred timers, deadline equality/overflow, hidden/invalid-clock contexts and sink-induced delays cannot subscribe. Just-inside-limit grants remain useful. Exact reviewer F2 and minimal reproduction pass. |
| F3 | Fixed in `b34ca56a79515104d7412d46f0e20d7045a5ba8e`: denied/revoked state and its original provenance remain terminal for that session; conflicting passive evidence is retained as unapplied observations. | Deferred grants and subsequent prompt/unknown/granted changes cannot reopen denial or revocation. A new explicit session still acquires. Exact reviewer F3 and minimal reproduction pass. |
| F4 | Fixed in `b34ca56a79515104d7412d46f0e20d7045a5ba8e`: original GPS watch/options are carried on error, local timeout and platform-failure events. | One-event buffers preserve settings for sample/watch code 1/2/3/unknown errors, detached copies and redacted messages; nonterminal watch errors still permit success. Exact reviewer F4 and minimal reproduction pass. |

Node **22.22.3** results:

- Author suite: **67 pass, 0 fail** — original 60 plus seven new regressions. All seven new tests failed on the old source before the fix.
- Exact, unedited reviewer `probes.test.mjs`: **22 pass, 0 fail**, exit 0. The preserved before-fix run is 18 pass/4 fail.
- Exact, unedited reviewer `reproduce.mjs`: **all four expected/actual checks pass**, exit 0; the before-fix output retains four mismatches.
- Source syntax and staged whitespace checks pass. Reviewer `review.md`, `probes.test.mjs` and `reproduce.mjs` SHA-256 values match their pre-fix values.

[Full disposition, commands, evidence locations and hashes](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/b34ca56a79515104d7412d46f0e20d7045a5ba8e/docs/phone-observations/review-fixes.md).

This is author fix evidence, not a new independent review verdict. Brain is asked to route reviewer52 a re-review of **exact head `b34ca56a79515104d7412d46f0e20d7045a5ba8e`**. No merge has been performed. Physical qualification/resource recordings remain not-run/inconclusive, real streams stay disabled by default, and Robert retains #18/#21 ownership with the local event boundary provisional. Refs #19.

@Robertzu43 accepted all six findings in [your review](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/52#pullrequestreview-5560453602). Pushed **`4aca76c34a5c1639dccad9cff6a01f00f7023ac2`**; [full disposition and commands](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/4aca76c34a5c1639dccad9cff6a01f00f7023ac2/docs/phone-observations/robert-review-fixes.md).

1. Every executable session finish now emits one local `session-stop` with `{reason, sharingState:'stopped', resumable}`, including event/duration budget, pagehide and freeze. One stop slot survives the ordinary cap; sink withdrawal does not recurse. Default bounded duration is 24h (maximum configurable 7d), with larger finite event/callback caps and the same 128-event retained buffer.
2. Added explicit resume under a new generation, a trusted-native-event bridge for missing userActivation, same-session explicit reacquisition after a grant, and best-effort screen wake lock with stop/timeout/late-grant cleanup. The trip factory exposes `resumeSharing(event)` for the **Reanudar** action. Actual app button binding is pending Q49 foundation/PR63; locked-screen/background capture remains unproven.
3. Location now defaults to `enableHighAccuracy:true`, with an explicit observable override. Measured accuracy/source remain independent of that hint.
4. Added `createTripPhoneObservations` to bind selected reviewed context, exact trip consent, fixed purpose, watch settings and optional wake lock. Missing or foreign-trip consent stays blocked; withdrawal clears consent. No physical qualification packet is invented while #9 is not-run.
5. Added an explicitly gated browser-managed motion path when requestPermission is absent; permission remains unknown. Existing express permission/denial/revocation protections remain.
6. Transient GPS errors have a separate one-second throttle and suppression count. Denial bypasses it and retires the watch; later useful fixes survive transient errors.

**Actual result:** Node 22.22.3, **82/82 author + unchanged recorder checks pass**. Fourteen new adapter regressions fail on b34ca56 and pass here, including a ten-hour synthetic foreground watch. The unchanged independent suite is **19/22**: P03/F4 expect high accuracy false, P06 expects absence of requestPermission to be unsupported. Those old expectations conflict with items 3/5; no reviewer file was changed. The preserved reproducer passes F1–F3 and differs only on F4's boolean. Fresh independent reviewer52 assessment is requested.

The inspected backend c752de8a3b424bcbc086764dc11052348b27e320 has no `/v1/trips/:id/sharing` route or the cited security spec. Q42 has the exact stop seam; authoritative server mapping remains pending your published contract. The adapter has no HTTP and cannot claim server receipt or prevent server alerts by itself. Location mapping must preserve original position.timestamp (no receipt-time fallback), strict four-field payloads, source-time/accuracy limits, bounded batches and stable retry keys.

Please confirm the adapter disposition at this exact SHA and publish the authoritative sharing contract when ready. This remains draft, unmerged, with physical qualification and app/backend integration explicitly pending.

Accepted the additional [review5560599386](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/52#pullrequestreview-5560599386), preserved its exact body and pushed tested corrections at **`4417cf699aee0f25337c23754a1d2561b334bd7f`**. Brain has now assigned component57 exclusive remaining correction ownership from this head; my driver UI work will not overlap its phone files.

This slice fixes blocked-diagnostic flooding, active/stopped/suspended coordinate retention and resumed consent, synthetic global aliases, queued sink boundaries, monitor fulfilment rejection, timer exceptions, sync GPS false-ok and distinct cancellation/clock reasons. Permission prompts have a separate120s bound from10s acquisition; code1 alone remains ambiguous pending actual permission evidence. Full [finding/handoff inventory](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/4417cf699aee0f25337c23754a1d2561b334bd7f/docs/phone-observations/robert-5560599386-handoff.md).

Actual: **95/95 author/recorder pass**. Unchanged complementary57 probes **11/12** (B1 small-cap raw counting remains); unchanged52 lifecycle **14/16** (specific timer reason and code1-only denied expectations differ). No old probe was edited or recounted as green. Component57 owns remaining B1, portable instructions, full disposition and GPS factory→Q42 queue/uploader composition. Active-trip scope is GPS-only; retained raw motion is opt-in evidence capability, subject to your confirmation. No second uploader, physical qualification, /sharing endpoint, independent approval or merge is claimed.

@Robertzu43, the corrections for both [review5560453602](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/52#pullrequestreview-5560453602) and [review5560599386](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/52#pullrequestreview-5560599386) are now on exact PR head **`9f87e2c08be8ac9e9324136fd0c4401ad8823bc6`**. Q52 independently checked this exact archive and published [scoped technical ACCEPT](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/pull/52#pullrequestreview-5560744965). This does not dismiss your requests or clear merge/integration.

[Full per-item correction report](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/9f87e2c08be8ac9e9324136fd0c4401ad8823bc6/docs/phone-observations/robert-current-disposition.md) and [immutable independent evidence, portable commands and original red results](https://github.com/Bimbi-Dev/andes-hackathon/blob/2769afd6eb86f0171cb1c4100dc238d40d546c7c/review-probes/phone-9f87e2c/README.md).

| Latest blocker | Exact-head disposition |
| --- | --- |
| B1 — callbacks counted before throttle | Motion useful-work counting now follows interval suppression. Raw callbacks retain a separate finite safety cap and observable counts. The small-cap60Hz control passes; both cap controls preserve useful GPS. |
| B2 — repeated GPS errors exhaust ordinary events | Separate transient-error throttle and suppression counter;1000-error control preserves a useful fix. Denial remains immediately observable. |
| B3 — blocked acquisitions exhaust the shared budget | Coalesce diagnostics per stream/reason. The cap10 polling control keeps useful GPS alive. |
| B4 — coordinates retained on revoke | Purge adapter buffer and queued-but-undelivered coordinates, including after stop/suspension and after buffer eviction. Clear consent/intents and prevent precise resume. Queue composition stops/purges capture synchronously before asynchronous scope deletion and exposes deletion failure/retry. Already delivered copies/network sends cannot be recalled. |
| B5 — synthetic global alias | Require detached injected platform and clock; reject global/prototype aliases and directly reused native capabilities at construction and acquisition. The inert `Object.create(globalThis)` reproduction is rejected. This is a configuration guard, not a JavaScript security sandbox. |

| Should-fix | Exact-head disposition |
| --- | --- |
| S1 — missing terminal event | Reserved local `session-stop` survives ordinary budget exhaustion; reentrant stop delivers once without nested sink calls. Backend acknowledgement remains pending. |
| S2 — code1 prompt dismissal | Code1 alone remains ambiguous; fresh browser-confirmed denial is terminal. Independent controls prove that an older passive grant cannot reopen confirmed denial or promote ambiguity while a distinct fresh query is pending. Prompt permits a new explicit retry. |
| S3 — timeout before permission answer | Separate finite120s permission wait from10s post-grant acquisition. A useful pending grant can outlast acquisition duration without burning extra requests. Inclusive prompt, acquisition and session deadlines are checked even when timers are delayed. These are engineering choices, not device measurements. |
| S4 — `geo` stream name | Public stop events now use `geolocation`. |
| S5 — synchronous denial/stop reports success | Acquisition returns its settled failure/cancellation result after sink delivery. Ambiguous code1 returns `ok:false` with permission unknown until browser evidence. |
| S6 — unhandled fulfilment rejection | Observer fulfilment/listener faults and rejection are caught and counted. |
| S7 — timer throw strands motion request | Retire token, consume late promise rejection, return attributed `timer-unavailable`. |
| S8 — cancellation/clock reason codes | Stream cancellation while session remains live is obsolete-request; request-clock regression has clock attribution. Both controls pass. |
| S9 — sink re-entry during mutations | Capture and queue events; flush at settled transition boundaries. Explicit request/permission barriers retain cancellation before native work. Synchronous native-callback and nonrecursive stop controls pass. |
| S10 — three event serializations | One retained capture plus one detached delivery copy; snapshot isolation and pending-coordinate purge are retained. |
| S11 — personal reproduction paths | PATH-based Node and disposable archive variables replace personal paths. Historical probes are published byte-identically with original hashes. |

Earlier six findings are also addressed explicitly: R1 retains local terminal emission and longer finite trip budgets; R2 adds explicit resume, trusted synchronous legacy gesture support and best-effort visible-screen wake lock; R3 requests high accuracy while retaining measured-source uncertainty; R4 binds reviewed context and exact trip consent through the factory; R5 exposes gated browser-managed motion with unknown permission; R6 is the separate transient-error throttle. UI binding and actual device qualification remain separate evidence.

**Motion/upload scope for your confirmation:** active-trip sharing is GPS-only. Raw motion remains explicit opt-in, qualification-gated #19/#9 confounder/resource tooling outside the trip controller; no rule consumes it or infers crash, assault or sleep. Please confirm whether this disposition of your removal recommendation is acceptable. The new `createQueuedTripPhoneObservations` delegates the existing Q42 sink/drain/flush/tripStatus/revokeTrip API; it adds no duplicate uploader.

**The demo upload requirement is still an open integration gate.** Queue PR66's new repair9bc7ff4 is awaiting Q47 review; the last independent verdict remains FIX at9b53b74. Actual adapter→reviewed queue→backend upload has not run and is held with Q44/Q46 until queue clearance. Robert PR74's published sharing/status routes are under separate review and are not adopted here. A local stop event is not server acknowledgement or prevention of server alerts.

Independent Node24.17.0 results: author/recorder102, complementary12, separately versioned contract22, lifecycle16 and new denial/deadline/privacy controls5: **157 current checks pass**. Untouched originals remain17/22, prior contract-v2 remains20/22 and prior lifecycle14/16. Q52 independently evaluated the explicit accuracy/browser-managed-motion, prompt/code1 and timer-reason changes; original failed assertions and outputs remain preserved.

Please re-review **`9f87e2c08be8ac9e9324136fd0c4401ad8823bc6`**, including the motion scope and finite prompt bound. Your CHANGES_REQUESTED reviews remain binding. No merge, deployment, issue closure, iPhone lock/background qualification, matched battery/data, delivery or physical-safety claim follows from these synthetic results. Refs #19.
